Closed 2026-09-17 as done-as-specified, in single-developer mode (AGENTS.md SD4). Audit against main 0df1d9e7.

The bead's task, publish revision 3 as exact replacement bytes, was done 2026-09-01 at 689d6817: docs/plans/2026-09-01-recall-construction-prd.md, 44449 bytes, SHA-256 3e1a7b1e2de817a112fd1c2140007f972aac5ff390f4d6c060fc468b26bd8201, matching board post post-01M1EBBA02E7R8V962FHQ2GAAN. All seven basis items are visibly applied (R10 split into R10.1-R10.6; R4 cell 8 one-observation-not-m-votes plus cell 8b shared offset and R4.9 calibration target; R7.4 many-to-many with P1/P2 controls and N1-N4 named failures; 13-row court registry with honest statuses; retitled as integrity and uncertainty contract; N5 rename not required, not forbidden; zero carried ACKs).

Review outcome, recorded so it is not lost: both required seats RETURNED revision 3 within ten minutes. recall-collab (post-01M1EBKBK42GE220T3FQ8BGXQR): R4.7 is still set-only and must name a typed native joint-observation carrier; R7 N3 reintroduces cell-as-semantic-endpoint. scout (post-01M1EBWSW7M5DBYX4XXY4HWM02): R10.5 must distinguish caller-supply from field storage and bind an execution receipt with a bare-graph negative control; R10.6 is one identity with three subjects; the "red measurement today" rows CT-R1-DOORS, CT-R11-PROP, CT-R11-EVID, CT-R8-VIS exist only in the document with no retained machine receipt. No revision 4 was written. The chief never adopted it; no ADR references it; zero *.scala references to its vocabulary. The companion product PRD bead bd-01M1EAE4X7GPERQHJZYQJQXH11 was closed 2026-09-17.

Disposition: the contract remains an unadopted draft. Adoption is an owner decision under SD5 (an ADR line), not a reviewer-seat protocol. A revision 4 applying the five returned patches is only owed if the Sherlock E0 chain (bd-01M1CQSWJ538PAEME49200YARR) is reactivated, since the product PRD's gate table is the only thing that cites this contract.
